test_cnn_lstm_forward: test the CNNLSTM model forward pass with a SampleList containing text and image tensors
build_cnn_lstm_model: build a CNNLSTM model instance using model config then call build and init_losses
create_sample_list: create a SampleList with text image and target tensors for the CNNLSTM model
configure_cnn_lstm: configure the CNNLSTM model using Configuration with a defaults YAML config path
register_clevr_vocab: register clevr_text_vocab_size and clevr_num_final_outputs in the MMF registry
